name: Moonbrook Schoolhouse
summary: In Moonbrook's northwestern corner, the schoolhouse stands abandoned under Defias occupation. A small graveyard lies behind the hall where Stalvan Mistmantle once taught local children.

sections.title: A Beacon Fallen into Shadow
sections.body: Moonbrook's schoolhouse once welcomed children before ruin and bandits overtook the town. After Stalvan Mistmantle began tutoring local children, the mayor commissioned him to run a school. Students filled the hall in Moonbrook's brighter days, when the town prospered. Now outlaws occupy the abandoned building, and weathered headstones in its rear cemetery look out over Westfall's decline.

sections.title: Secrets in the Floorboards
sections.body: An old footlocker on the schoolhouse's main floor holds an unsent letter about Stalvan Mistmantle's arrival in Moonbrook. The letter recounts how he tutored local children before the mayor commissioned him to build a new schoolhouse. A separate letter, found later in Goldshire, says regional troubles forced Stalvan to leave his post and seek work as a private tutor.

faq.q: What was this building originally used for?
faq.answer: Moonbrook's schoolhouse was built to give local children a formal education. Its broad hall resembles a town hall, reflecting the ambition and pride the township held before its fall.
Stalvan Mistmantle was a learned scholar who became the schoolhouse's headmaster. Letters he left behind tell more about his career.

faq.q: Why is the schoolhouse abandoned now?
faq.answer: Economic strife brought Moonbrook down, and the Defias Brotherhood took over southern Westfall. The town's civic institutions fell, and bandits now overrun the abandoned schoolhouse.

faq.q: What can be found inside the schoolhouse today?
faq.answer: An old, dusty footlocker on the ground floor holds an unsent letter. Alliance investigators tracking Stalvan Mistmantle can find it inside.

angles.text: The abandoned schoolhouse reminds you how far Westfall has fallen from the Crown's protection. A center of learning now shelters outlaws.
